_README: This file is for MANUAL CURATION of discovered operations
_INSTRUCTIONS: After running static analysis, copy operations here and add semantic information

_MANUAL_FIELDS.description: Smooths image using Gaussian distribution kernel. Most common blur type.
_MANUAL_FIELDS.commonUse: Remove noise, soften edges, create depth of field effect
_MANUAL_FIELDS.performance: Medium - slows down significantly at radius > 50

_MANUAL_ENHANCEMENT.name: radius
_MANUAL_ENHANCEMENT.description: The radius of the Gaussian kernel. Larger values = more blur.
_MANUAL_ENHANCEMENT.notes: Values > 50 can be very slow. 0 has no effect.

_MANUAL_FIELDS.description: Adjusts overall brightness and contrast of the image
_MANUAL_FIELDS.commonUse: Correct underexposed photos, increase contrast for flat images
_MANUAL_FIELDS.performance: Fast - operates on each pixel independently

_MANUAL_ENHANCEMENT.name: brightness
_MANUAL_ENHANCEMENT.description: Brightness adjustment. Positive = brighter, negative = darker.
_MANUAL_ENHANCEMENT.notes: Values near ±150 cause clipping (loss of detail)

_MANUAL_ENHANCEMENT.name: contrast
_MANUAL_ENHANCEMENT.description: Contrast adjustment. Positive = more contrast, negative = less contrast.
_MANUAL_ENHANCEMENT.notes: High contrast can make images look harsh

_EXAMPLES.increaseContrast: brightness(0, 50) - Add punch to flat image

_MANUAL_FIELDS.description: Inverts all colors to their opposites (negative effect)
_MANUAL_FIELDS.commonUse: Create negative effect, artistic purposes, mask inversion

_CURATION_GUIDELINES.menuPath: Where to find it in the app (exact menu path)
_CURATION_GUIDELINES.commonUse: When/why users would use this (real-world scenarios)
_CURATION_GUIDELINES.destructive: Does it permanently modify pixels? (vs adjustment layer)
_CURATION_GUIDELINES.undoable: Can it be undone with Ctrl+Z?
_CURATION_GUIDELINES.relatedOperations: Similar operations users might want to try
